newsitem.title: INDIA: India Voltas wins 1.15 bln rupees order.
newsitem.headline: India Voltas wins 1.15 bln rupees order.

text.p: Indian appliance firm Voltas Ltd said on Tuesday its fully-owned subsidiary won a 1.15 billion rupee contract for heating, ventilation and air conditioning services in the passenger terminal complex at Hong Kong's new airport.

A company statement said that Voltas International Ltd (VIL) was awarded a contract for the heating, ventilation and air conditioning services and associated electrcial work in the passenger terminal complex of the new airport under contruction on the Chek Lap Kok island, off the coast of Lantau island in Hong Kong.
"VIL's excellent track record and experience in the providing of electro-mechanical services to some of the most modern airports worldwide contributed to it being selected ...," it said.

The firm said it was installing a wide spectrum of air conditioning equipment with total installed cooling tonnage of 17,500 TR. The contract also covers the production and installation of ventilation and air conditioning ducting, insulation, fire rakes etc.
Voltas said over 450 skilled operators from India and 100 from the Philippines have been sent to Hong Kong for the project.
